[V12.3.3](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x20-V12-Files-Resources.md#v123-file-execution-requirements)

Current:
> V12.3.3 Verify that user-submitted filename metadata is validated or ignored to prevent the disclosure or execution of remote files **(RFI), which may also lead to SSRF**.

Phrase "RFI may lead to SSRF" is not really adequate. If you have an RFI (request is made to remote address and content from remote location is executed as program code), you already have SSRF (request is made to remote location) - but not vice versa.


Proposal (needs language correction):
> V12.3.3 Verify that user-submitted filename metadata is validated or ignored to prevent the disclosure or execution of remote files **via Remote File Inclusion (RFI) or Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attacks**.

This issue should be fixed for v4.0.2 and I'll come back to LFI/RFI/SSRF requirements for ASVS v4.1.
title: V12.3.2 RFI and SSRF
